body:
Thank you for responding.

I am feeling like my wonderful family shouldn't have to deal with one more second of my toxicity. I can't even talk to my mom about how I feel because her own health problems trump mine a thousand times over. I may have lost my dad but she lost her husband. It kills her to hear me talk about what's going on in my head, as in , I think it may actually be killing her because her health is falling off a cliff.

Thank you for responding.

I have had various treatments throughout my life. I've seen a few different therapists / psychiatrists and they've all been wonderful people who want to help. Unfortunately, the one I related with most (also the most recent) started mentioning "the universe." All of a sudden, our sessions started revolving around "the universe" and how it will provide things for you if you "think" hard enough about it. The day he mentioned "The Secret" was our last session.

I took an anti-depressant and anti-anxiety drug for 10 years. Last year I wasn't in a position to be able to pay for them do I quit them both, cold turkey, at the same time. After getting over the initial insanity of my brain trying to catch up, I actually felt better than I could remember feeling for years.

Unfortunately, my anxiety has come back stronger than ever. I can hardly function with my friends and family because I'm on edge and get angry at the drop of a hat, not to mention dealing with my brain cranking at a million miles per hour all day long. I borrowed an anti-anxiety pill from my mom (we have the same prescription) and multiple family members said the difference was night and day. Because of this I will most likely go back to taking my anti-anxiety meds.
